barriers.reason: Insulin pen requires refrigeration; utility shutoff risk may spoil medication.

alternatives.text: Clinician completes utility medical certification form to delay disconnection for refrigerated insulin.
Apply through CEDA (Cook County) for income-based LIHEAP utility bill help; check funding window.

barriers.reason: 1pm visit conflicts with warehouse 7-3:30 shift; loses half shift, written up; prior no-shows.

alternatives.text: Ask diabetes educator for an after-4pm or Saturday appointment to avoid work conflict.
Schedule eye/other visit same day and campus as existing visit, or use telehealth if exam not needed.

barriers.reason: Workday meals from gas station; difficult to maintain carb-consistent, diabetes-appropriate diet.

alternatives.text: Apply via Illinois ABE (abe.illinois.gov) for SNAP income-based food benefits; expedited in 7 days if eligible.
Use Greater Chicago Food Depository locator for a pantry open Saturday/non-work day; pair with dietitian.
